title: rect
body:
## rect

Fills an axis-aligned rectangle of width x height pixels whose top-left pixel is at (x, y), covering columns x to x + width - 1 and rows y to y + height - 1, on a named layer and frame. Pixels are replaced, not blended: an opaque colour overwrites the selected layer and frame, and transparent [0, 0, 0, 0] erases. Choose it for backgrounds, panels and blocks; a full-canvas rect is the usual way to give a frame an opaque background.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The whole rectangle must lie inside the canvas (x + width and y + height at most the canvas size); it is rejected, not clipped. It must take its sprite input from the immediately preceding node.

Native binding: `Image:drawPixel`. Output kind: `["sprite"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sprite` | one node | yes | `sprite` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layer` | Name of the existing layer the rectangle is drawn on: the sprite's first layer (default "base") or a layer added by an earlier layer node. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64}` | **required** |
| `frame` | One-based number of the frame the rectangle is drawn on: 1 is the sprite's first frame, 2 the frame added by the first frame node, and so on. Only that frame changes. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":32}` | `1` |
| `x` | Zero-based column of the rectangle's left edge; it covers columns x to x + width - 1. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":255}` | **required** |
| `y` | Zero-based row of the rectangle's top edge; it covers rows y to y + height - 1, extending downwards. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":255}` | **required** |
| `colour` | RGBA colour written to every pixel of the rectangle: an opaque colour with alpha 255 replaces the pixels, and [0, 0, 0, 0] erases them to transparency. Colours are stored directly as RGB values and need not be in the palette. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":255,"required":true},"minItems":4,"maxItems":4}` | **required** |
| `width` | Number of columns the rectangle covers, from x to x + width - 1 (1 to 256). x + width must not exceed the canvas width. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":256}` | **required** |
| `height` | Number of rows the rectangle covers, from y downwards to y + height - 1 (1 to 256). y + height must not exceed the canvas height. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":256}` | **required** |
